turns.user_utterance: What do you need so I can verify my identity?
turns.assistant_response: To verify your identity, I’ll need valid identification documents (typically a government-issued ID such as a passport or national ID) and proof of your address (such as a recent utility bill or bank statement, depending on your country). You’ll also need to complete the in-app verification steps. Which country are you verified in, and are you using a passport or national ID?
